BiblicalUsage: Shua was a Canaanite, the daughter of Shuah, whom Judah married, and the mother of his three sons Er, Onan, and Shelah. In time she died, and Judah was comforted and went up to his sheepshearers at Timnath with his friend Hirah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Judah's story turns on this Canaanite wife. Her sons shaped his house, her death sent him to Timnath, and I hold that God works His purposes through the marriages men make, even the unwise ones.
